name: Ricardo Valenzuela
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. After years spent running a successful family-owned restaurant in Santiago, he found himself providing food for a small rally team passing through town. His dedication to fresh, high-quality ingredients and ability to adapt to the demanding schedules of motorsport quickly made him a sought-after commodity. He joined Reiza Studios Factory after a successful stint catering for their endurance events. 

Ricardo's approach is rooted in understanding the nutritional needs of the team, from the mechanics needing high-energy sustenance to the drivers requiring a balanced diet for peak performance. He prides himself on using locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, bringing a taste of Chilean authenticity to the paddock. What makes Ricardo distinctive is his calm demeanor under pressure; he's the culinary rock of the team, ensuring everyone is well-fed and ready to perform, no matter the challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, thinning at the crown
physical.description: Ricardo is a stout man with kind eyes and a warm smile, radiating a comforting presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and food pairing ideas.
Insists on personally taste-testing every dish before it's served, even if it's something he's made a hundred times before.
Plays traditional Chilean folk music softly while preparing food, claiming it improves the flavor.
